scripts.prepare: npm --prefix src/ts ci --include=dev && npm --prefix src/ts run build
scripts.contracts:compile: tsp compile contracts/typespec --output-dir target/contracts/typespec && tsp compile contracts/docs-serving.tsp --no-emit && tsp compile contracts/persistence/idempotency-record.tsp --no-emit && tsp compile contracts/rate-limit-v2/typespec --no-emit
scripts.contracts:polyglot-generate: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path tools/contract-parity/Cargo.toml --bin persistence_codegen -- --output-root target/schema-convergence --report target/schema-convergence/receipt.json
scripts.contracts:compare: node scripts/compare-authorities.mjs && cargo run --quiet --manifest-path tools/contract-parity/Cargo.toml -- && npm run contracts:polyglot-generate && npm run contracts:generated-check && npm run contracts:cross-translate
scripts.contracts:validate: node scripts/validate-contracts.mjs && node scripts/validate-docs-serving.mjs && node scripts/validate-rate-limit-v2.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:compare && npm run contracts:validate && npm run function-bodies:check
scripts.function-bodies:check: npm run function-bodies:compile && npm run function-bodies:runtime && npm run function-bodies:e2e
scripts.persistence:check: npm run persistence:catalog && npm run persistence:data-plane
scripts.ores-mw:check: python3 -m unittest tests/test_ores_mw_config.py tests/test_ores_mw_output_hardening.py tests/test_ores_mw_env_config.py -v && python3 scripts/ores_mw_config.py check && tsp compile contracts/ores-mw-config/typespec --no-emit && npm run ores-mw:compile && npm run ores-mw:validate
scripts.verify: npm run contracts:compile && npm run contracts:check && npm run ores-mw:check && npm run zpkg:check && node scripts/check-source-layout.mjs
